rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a situation that creates pressure or feels mentally stressful.

example.jyutping: fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 aat3 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the stressful thing is irritating, bothersome, or generally getting on your nerves.

example.english: Having to make changes all the time is really stressful.
example.traditional: 成日改嚟改去，真係好煩。
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 goi2 lei4 goi2 heoi3 zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4

rows.note: Use this when something is mentally taxing because it requires difficult thought or problem-solving.

example.english: Working out how to calculate this problem is really stressful.
example.traditional: 呢條數點計先，真係好傷腦筋。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 dim2 gai3 sin1 zan1 hai6 hou2 soeng1 nou5 gan1
